name: Borken (Hesse, Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the red lion of the city arms of Borken (Hessen).
history: The flag was approved together with the arms on 26 February 1951, after the Hessian State Ministry had granted the city the right to change its former arms and flag.

features.role: Hessian lion from the city arms
